The following events took place in '''3625 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Invasion of Manaan|invades]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] to seize its supply of [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]].<ref name="TOR:DitW" /><ref name="TOR_updates:7.0">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref>
*[[Darth Malgus]] is [[Mission to Elom|captured]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]].<ref name="TOR:RoN">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref><ref name="TOR_updates:7.0" />
*[[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] and [[Heta Kol]] [[Showdown on Ruhnuk|duel]] in an arena on [[Ruhnuk]]. A fight between the two factions starts and the [[Hidden Chain]] retreats from the planet.<ref name="TOR:SoR" /><ref name="TOR_updates:7.2">{{TOR_updates|7.2}}</ref>
